baseline_prompt_en: Create a photorealistic cinematic editorial photograph built around a modern Republic of Korea special-forces concept. The subject is the same unmistakably adult woman from the reference portrait, preserving her facial proportions, brown eyes, natural skin texture, and long dark wavy hair, partly secured beneath a matte tactical helmet. She pauses at the edge of a rain-darkened training compound, one gloved hand adjusting her radio headset while she scans the corridor ahead. She wears an olive and charcoal combat uniform, fitted plate carrier, utility pouches, and a compact carbine secured across her chest. Her posture is disciplined and alert rather than posed. Emphasize recognizable facial fidelity and credible layered tactical gear. Cool dawn haze, wet concrete reflections, restrained directional light, and shallow depth of field create a grounded, high-end military editorial atmosphere.

interpretation_provenance.resolution: A modern Republic of Korea special-forces training aesthetic with tactical uniform, protective equipment, communications gear, and disciplined situational awareness, using the attached portrait as the appearance reference.
